## Independence and source-transfer assessment

Independent reviewer authored no engineering, source map, model or plan. Prior participation was independent Delivery/milestone assessment only. Read the complete actual ownership/removal/consumer diff, current approved Design displacement/representation rules and M4/TG-07/08/final allocation, selected original clauses through Git, actual remaining consumers and current review records. No engineering, activity or work was edited.

The exact deletion set is the four mapped process/transaction spec/test-spec files and their two ADRs, with no archive, redirect, operational record or seventh file removed. This follows the explicitly selected Design retention policy, not a blanket loss-of-history rule. The living Release contract retains applicable population, semantic-version classes, routine/special distinctions, required gate/evidence fields, trusted/manual fallback boundaries, public observation, failures/emergency/no-overwrite, generated markers, profile/literal/timing formats and separate proof owners. Historical lifecycle gates and rollout commands are explicitly superseded rather than copied into a new current requirement. The approved grouped source map preserves decisions and representative acceptance intent; no missing surviving source obligation was identified in this M4 review.

The architecture diff removes the standing subsection, exactly nine initial Release-and-adapter-evidence paragraphs, selected post-bootstrap fallback paragraph and obsolete source/ADR navigation. The other three adapter/history paragraphs and complete named-version public npm flow remain. The owner pointer preserves final-Verify adoption conditioning. Removing the selected obsolete Transaction spec navigation is a necessary current-consumer correction for its expressly authorized source removal, not an additional responsibility transfer. FU-013 keeps Distribution/Installation open with maintainer/Route receiving ownership and next proposal, and conditions Release adoption on final Verify. Other follow-ups are unchanged.

## Independent direct evidence and applicability

A Python/Git assertion checked the deletion set equals exactly the six authorized originals, complete Public npm publication flow bytes equal the M3 base, each of the three retained adapter/history paragraphs remains exact, and all Mermaid blocks in the mixed architecture are unchanged. Operational baseline SHA256 remains9859cd5ef43ff2cb1216a03e53b2ef5d45919cca3bf5868dc6d81d87682b43a1; activation inventory remains09a4f682976282dcaa131818f495717909230098dea59f8efb3ffa1790d73cde. Both were compared to the base and actual current files. Git diff across scripts/packages/skills/schemas/templates/.github/dist is empty for M4.

Actual rg search of scripts/packages/skills/CI/current governance and release guidance found historical change-directory references to the still-required literal baseline and test follow-up strings, not a runtime reader of the removed six prose paths. These retained operational dependencies were not mistaken for removable prose. Old source IDs and historical citations remain history, not current alternative definitions. Current navigation uses Release and the separate evidence ref. M3 package/CLI/authorization/check/configuration subjects are unchanged; its substantive integrated proof remains applicable to this source-only slice, supplemented by deletion-aware current-reader checks. Final whole-change applicability and actual final range CI remain separate obligations.

Author evidence release-m4-implementation-r1 reports model/reference and prose checks passed, readability passed with150 advisories, direct retained-byte/reader checks passed. `bash scripts/ci.sh --mode pr --base 6b6db7fcf98d78c2e1f15afe0b5b9ca37d3261d8 --head a0a59c660cea5f062dba93090ed350f8eeac2157` passed all8 selected checks: record_store.schema, model.validate, boundary_first.regression, skills.regression, artifact_lifecycle.validate, change_metadata.regression, change_metadata.validate and rigorloop_cli.test; selected total138.07s, deletion-aware lifecycle81.61s. The earlier explicit-path mode failed on missing removed source inputs and remains failed; the existing revision-bound mode then exercised deletion handling without changing validators or omitting the deleted paths. No release suite or public operation was independently rerun by this source-only review.

Design r5 and Delivery r2 explain their current replacement reliance, but Proposal r5 still carries necessary original-source basis without its assessor's disposition. This supported finding prevents a clean M4 handoff despite sound engineering/retention checks. Another assessor's statement cannot waive it.

| Item | Result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spec alignment | concern | Engineering map satisfied; M4 current-assessment reliance remains incomplete. |
| Test coverage | pass | Existing deletion-aware current-reader checks and unchanged integrated production proof apply. |

| Error handling | pass | Failed explicit invocation preserved; revision-aware checks used without validator relaxation. |
| Architecture boundaries | pass | One Release owner, scoped mixed paragraphs, no unrelated transfer or new authority. |
| Compatibility | pass | Operational baseline, activation history, package/configuration and historical npm/adapter content preserved. |
| Security/privacy | pass | No executable/credential/publication changes; prior confidentiality proof unchanged. |
| Derived artifact currency | pass | No package/archive inputs changed; current-reader/reference proof supplements unchanged M3 identity. |
| Unrelated changes | pass | Six source removals, scoped architecture/navigation/FU013 and earlier reviewed factual model update only. |
| Validation evidence | concern | Mechanical/semantic removal evidence sufficient; Proposal current-reliance claim overstates recorded disposition. |

## Finding release-m4-f1

- Finding ID: release-m4-f1
- Severity: minor.
- Location: docs/changes/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation/reviews/proposal-review-r5.json and release-m4-implementation-r1 assessment-reliance claim.
- Evidence: Proposal-review-r5 remains marked current but includes now-removed specs/release-process-contract.md, specs/release-transaction-automation.md and docs/adr/ADR-20260523-release-process-contract.md among its exact subjects. Its body explicitly says unchanged source contracts/ADRs remain the direction basis; neither its body nor its current applicability reason ends that reliance. Design r5 explicitly disposes reliance on the six originals, and Delivery r2 relies on the current map, but those assessors cannot dispose the Proposal assessor's basis. The M4 implementation summary therefore overclaims that all three original assessors ended removed-original reliance. M4 and TG-08 require each still-needed original assessor's current-reliance disposition.
- Required outcome: Obtain the original independent Proposal assessor's bounded current-reliance renewal/disposition on the actual post-removal context. Preserve r5 and its original subjects/judgment; do not retarget it, restore duplicate original authority or require engineering changes solely for review bookkeeping. Record the corrected evidence/applicability and return for bounded M4 reassessment. No new product/Design decision is needed.
- Safe resolution path: original Proposal assessor records bounded renewal/disposition; implementation owner corrects evidence claim; this original reporter reassesses M4 on unchanged engineering.
- needs-decision rationale: none; responsible assessor owns the missing reliance determination.

## Handoff

No original files should be restored or historical judgments rewritten as a bookkeeping repair. Route the finding to its named original assessor and return for bounded reassessment. This is M4 review only; final independent whole-change Code Review and distinct Verify remain required after M4 settles. No final adoption, branch/PR readiness, hosted success or publication is claimed.
